children: New York state has filed a lawsuit against Polymarket
, alleging that it's running an illegal gambling operation in the state, New York Attorney General Letitia James and Governor Kathy Hochul said Thursday.
The suit seeks to stop the company from operating as an unlicensed gambling business and requires Polymarket
to pay fines, forfeit illegal gains, and pay restitution to users.

The complaint contends that Polymarket's prediction markets fit the legal definition of gambling in that the outcomes of the events on which users are trading are uncertain and outside the control of the bettor or rely on a game of chance.
